statement:
PROVISIONAL (machine-made from the Lean declaration; stage 1 writes it in words): Every geometric inverse image has these algebraic lifts and canonical constant maps. Source: Stacks 00YV, 03D2, 099L (blueprint: lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence). Proof: transport algebraic operations through finite products preserved by L. The existing generalized-section equations define the transported ring and module actions. Transport morphisms through the same underlying-sheaf isomorphisms. Since L is a left adjoint and preserves the terminal object, it preserves coproducts of the terminal object and hence constant sheaves. This gives the comparison naturally in every coefficient ring, and its maps are the canonical constant-sheaf maps.
